title: Pediatric endocrinologist visit (growth, weight, puberty)
what: The doctor checks how your child is growing and developing, and whether hormones are getting in the way.
why: If your child is noticeably shorter or taller than others, is gaining extra weight, puberty began too early or too late, or thyroid problems are suspected.
duration: the visit usually takes 20 to 40 minutes, test results in a few days
tell_doctor: Your child's height and weight by year - from the record or your notes
How your child eats, sleeps and moves

prepare.title: Height by year
prepare.text: Copy your child's height and weight for past years from the medical record - this is the most important thing for the doctor.

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: The doctor may order hormone tests, usually in the morning on an empty stomach. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Talk
prepare.text: Explain to your child that the doctor will look at how they are growing, and it does not hurt.

bring: The medical record with height measurements
Earlier tests and a hand X-ray, if done
steps: The doctor asks you about your child's development
Examines your child - if needed also signs of puberty, gently and with a parent present
May send for tests or a hand X-ray
Explains the conclusion and the plan
feel: A teenager may feel awkward - you can ask for the exam to be shorter
after: Keep track of height and weight - write them down every few months
Come back for a follow-up when the doctor says
red_flags: Your child drinks a lot, urinates often, is losing weight and is listless - see a doctor urgently
Acetone smell on the breath, vomiting or drowsiness - call your local emergency number

faq.q: My child is the shortest in class - is it an illness?
faq.a: Not always. Often it runs in the family. The doctor will look at the height by year.

faq.q: Why an X-ray of the hand?
faq.a: It shows how mature the bones are and how much more the child can grow.

reminders.text: Pediatric endocrinologist tomorrow. Write down your child's height and weight for past years.
